cycle_readiness.current_status: departed positive; section and section velocity remain positive
cycle_readiness.cycle_return_event: only after the section becomes negative, a later negative-to-nonnegative crossing with positive orientation
cycle_readiness.first_readiness_event: section velocity changes from positive to nonpositive
cycle_readiness.section: n0 dot (q-q0), with n0 the normalized initial physical rate

forbidden: authorize a complete cycle before a negative section is observed
infer a cycle from a linear turning forecast
treat a physical failure as retryable chart failure
propagate a rejected endpoint or midpoint
alter or lag the original free field
invoke a fixed-Q physical clock or reaction

outcomes.numerical_failure: minimum-span, replay, or budget gate failed
outcomes.open_transient: bounded exact continuation passed but section velocity remains positive; update forecast and cost before another tranche
outcomes.turn_bracketed: cycle-readiness turning point bracketed; authorize only a definitions-only negative-section acquisition manifest

truth_system.chart: fresh strict conservative metric patch at every accepted endpoint
truth_system.role: offline physical-cycle truth acquisition for a later event-to-event slow map
